employees.label: Employees
employees.definition: Total employees, split by the 10-K into those based in the United States and those based internationally.

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 1, Employees
source.quote: As of December 31, 2024, we had a total of 1,534 employees, of whom 453 were based in the United States and 1,081 were based internationally.

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 1, Employees

sites.name: Corporate headquarters
sites.description: About 190,000 square feet of leased office space in Northern Virginia serving as corporate headquarters (address on the 10-K cover: 1850 Towers Crescent Plaza, Tysons Corner, VA).

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 2, Properties
source.quote: As of December 31, 2024, we leased approximately 190,000 square feet of office space at a location in Northern Virginia that serves as our corporate headquarters.

notes: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) discloses only a U.S. vs international employee split and a headquarters lease; most of its balance sheet is bitcoin, which has no geographic footprint. The 10-K also gives long-lived assets and revenue by U.S. / EMEA / other regions (in thousands of dollars); long-lived assets were not recorded because the values are stated in thousands and would need rescaling, and revenue is in the records. Besides headquarters it uses about 20,000 sq ft elsewhere in the U.S. and about 87,000 sq ft abroad, without naming sites. No state or tax-by-country data exists.
